scope: Admin UI/auth/navigation/contracts/test claims across all nine audit reports
method: Static source tracing under data-integrity-audit skill. No runtime/DB assertions established; confidence HIGH for direct source facts, MEDIUM for predicted runtime impact. No application files changed.

findings.claim: Trust route lacks role checks; inventory extends claim to bookings/providers.
findings.current: Trust rejects non-trust roles; bookings/providers also gate roles. Backend still enforces access. Old test.fixme assertion is active now, but stale explanatory comment remains.

findings.claim: Auditor support navigation and service mutation forms conflict with backend permissions.
findings.current: Support nav/page excludes auditor; services checks canMutateServices to hide mutation UI. Unconditional header notifications still links support for every role; this is a distinct residual UX issue.

findings.claim: Guarantee dropdown allows illegal transitions, leading to backend 409 crash.
findings.current: UI transition table and terminal rendering now exist. Claimed backend invalid-transition 409 is unsupported: updateStatus assigns any valid DTO enum without lifecycle validation. Thus UI gap fixed, backend invariant remains absent.

findings.claim: Complaint dossier renders blank name/email due to UserDetail contract mismatch.
findings.current: Canonical user fields are optional, operations getUser reexports users implementation, and dossier renders explicit user-ID / identity-redacted fallbacks. Backend still intentionally projects minimal PII; unavailable personal fields are not by themselves defects.

findings.claim: Analytics API allows support agents through adminBookingsRead.
findings.current: Controller now requires dedicated adminAnalyticsRead, whose policy permits operations administrator and auditor only. Platform-financial leak claim also overstated current response fields.

findings.claim: API inventory reuses GAP-18 for unpaginated complaints/trust endpoints.
findings.current: Complaints and trust now accept limit/offset and apply bounded queries. Filtering defect is separately DIA-004.

findings.claim: Bookings emergency banner matches description substring.
findings.current: Now counts booking.isEmergency true; backend derives flag from emergency category IDs.

findings.claim: Guarantee server actions throw on API failure and trigger error.tsx.
findings.current: Both status/re-service mutations redirect with error query and page renders alert; successful actions revalidate and redirect.

findings.claim: Seven admin pages load full unpaginated tables; search queries run sequentially.
findings.current: Search uses Promise.all; complaints/trust have server offset pagination, provider/users/bookings cursor pagination. Admin services still loads all categories then slices; guarantees backend caps default 50 without continuation and UI paginates only fetched slice. Search locally filters default first 20 complaints / 50 claims, so older matching records remain absent.

findings.claim: Bookings reads nextCursor without Load More control.
findings.current: Load more link passes cursor and current filters.

findings.claim: Database inventory reuses GAP-25 for audit-events user deletion CASCADE.
findings.current: ID collision with canonical GAP-10, not bookings pagination. Database-focused reviewer must resolve against complete migrations.

findings.claim: Provider highlight label mismatches; search highlights Dashboard.
findings.current: Shell normalizes Provider label and sets activeLabel null for Search.

findings.claim: Bookings table has no dossier navigation.
findings.current: Booking ID is now Link to detail.

findings.claim: Providers/support permanent placeholder panes consume 40% layout.
findings.current: Queue pages use real empty/list state and navigation controls; literal placeholder panes absent.

findings.claim: No explicit CSRF token beyond Origin checking and no login action rate limiter constitute security gap.
findings.current: No custom Next limiter exists, but backend login is throttled 5/min, global guard applies, lockout persists in credentials, UI handles 429. Session cookies Strict/HttpOnly/prod Secure. No exploit established; separate CSRF token absence alone is not vulnerability evidence. Runtime security testing not performed.

findings.claim: Shell hardcodes Chief Dispatcher and external avatar.
findings.current: Shell derives title/subtitle/initials from props/role, displays local initials avatar; backend session exposes email/displayName. Some older dossier callers pass only roles, producing honest role fallback rather than person identity.

findings.claim: Permanently disabled Corporate SSO button.
findings.current: No SSO button remains in admin source; login-form disabled state is only pending submit. LDAP ID text still appears but is unrelated to removed button.

findings.claim: Analytics/users/user-detail routes orphaned.
findings.current: Navigation links analytics/users, user table links detail. Prior inventory itself acknowledged guarantee-to-user links, so absolute zero inbound claim was inaccurate.

findings.claim: Unauthorized page has no session check.
findings.current: Page obtains session and redirects unauthenticated users to login.

findings.claim: No admin UI exists for review/photo moderation.
findings.current: Trust page provides review/photo UUID moderation forms wired via server actions to backend endpoints. Moderation browsing queue is still absent; current forms require externally known IDs. Original zero-UI claim fixed; richer queue is scope distinction.

findings.claim: Guarantee missing client transition table.
findings.current: Same claim as GAP-07; UI fixed, backend lifecycle guard absent. Do not count twice.

findings.claim: Bookings cursor without Load More.
findings.current: Same as GAP-25; fixed.

findings.claim: shortId copied across ten admin files.
findings.current: Ten app pages retain local shortId definitions despite shared lib formatter; maintainability duplication, no proven runtime bug.

findings.claim: Two conflicting getUser client implementations/types.
findings.current: Operations reexports canonical getUser; old operations UserDetail optional-field alias remains unused but no competing request implementation.

findings.claim: Two admin fetch wrappers have conflicting error semantics.
findings.current: Both preserve HTTP status, handle 204, map network failures to 503. Management wrapper adds bearer and downstream redirect helper; auth wrapper supports pre-session login. Duplication exists but claimed conflict not established.

findings.claim: Staff role lists duplicated across seven files with divergent permissions.
findings.current: Shared roles helper exists and services uses it; shell, search, several route arrays remain duplicated. Specific support/auditor mismatch fixed. No new unsupported permission divergence inferred from duplication alone.

findings.claim: Status label mappings duplicated across four admin files.
findings.current: Shared StatusBadge is used by booking/guarantee/user pages; provider/support/trust still use domain-specific inline status rendering. Blanket four duplicated mapping claim no longer accurate; remaining inline renderers are maintainability concern without demonstrated status bug.

findings.claim: 12/18 routes have zero automated coverage.
findings.current: Numerical absolute claim stale/unsupported: dashboard/login/bookings/users/unauthorized have E2E route coverage; guarantee detail has lifecycle unit tests; trust role regression test exists. Several dossier/CRUD/routes still lack dedicated behavior coverage. Unit-helper coverage is not full rendered-page or persistence coverage. Parent runs current admin tests; no tests rerun by this subagent. Historical inventory cites management-api.test.ts and features/search/search.test.ts, neither exists in current admin/src; do not treat those as present tests.

findings.claim: Support/trust filter only first fetched slice, masking matching older records.
findings.current: Both now expose subsequent pages, but filters still run after fetch-and-slice and are not sent to database. Support fetches 21 then slices 20, trust fetches 11 then slices 10; status/search matches on later pages invisible in current filter result; counts are slice-local.
